definitions.gloss: synthetic leather; artificial leather; imitation leather
definitions.explanation: A material made to look and feel like real leather, typically consisting of a fabric base coated with polyurethane or polyvinyl chloride. Used in clothing, furniture, bags, and automotive interiors as a cheaper, more uniform, and animal-free alternative to natural leather.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧ (synthetic) and ⟦{皮革|ひかく}→皮革：28433_hikaku⟧ (leather, hide). A formal term used especially on product labels and in commerce; spoken Japanese often uses shorter words like ⟦フェイク→フェイク：11282_feiku⟧レザー or ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧レザー.

USAGE:
- Used as a material noun, typically in attributive form with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鞄|かばん}.
- Common on product tags and labels in retail: {素材|ざいてい}: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of synthetic leather
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧: synthetic leather sofa
- ⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}: high-quality synthetic leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧: real leather / genuine leather — natural animal leather
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧レザー: artificial leather — casual / marketing term, synonymous
- ⟦フェイク→フェイク：11282_feiku⟧レザー: faux leather — casual English loanword, common in fashion
- ⟦ビニール→ビニール：11140_biniiru⟧レザー: vinyl leather — PVC-based imitation leather, older term
